source: PWA solar rooftop phases 1-2 daily meter reports (Cewe meters) under contract ธพ.(บล) 20/2566; TFRS 16 model v1.0

tariff.note: book price is the TFRS 16 model's price; PWA saving per kWh = grid price - book price

rules.counts_as: data gap (inverter data missing, usually communications)

day_status.missing_value: on a loss_* day the missing reading is null, never 0

curtailment.note: a site with more than 30 curtailment-note days is a curtailed site; curtailment is a PM issue, not an O&M KPI

performance.pi_free_group: per phase: sites with <= 30 curtailment-note days, pooled pi_pvsyst on ok days = PI_free

loss_model.curtailment_kwh: (PI_free - pi_pvsyst_site) * pvsyst_kwh on ok days, for curtailed sites, floored at 0
loss_model.under_performance_kwh: (0.95 * PI_free - pi_pvsyst_site) * pvsyst_kwh on ok days, for non-curtailed sites, floored at 0
loss_model.label: estimated

outage_event.definition: consecutive outage days of one site
outage_event.mttr_days: mean event length; planned tests / PWA-side work / floods reported separately
cause_keywords: มิเตอร์ชำรุด
ทดสอบ/ปิดตามแผน
บำรุงรักษา
งานฝั่ง กปภ.
ประปาทำการ
ฟิวส์ของประปา
ปรับพื้นที่
เบรกเกอร์/อุปกรณ์ไฟฟ้า
อินเวอร์เตอร์
หรี่จนหยุดผลิต
outage_event.cause_rule: first group whose keyword appears in the event's notes (its days' distinct notes joined)

meter_vs_inverter.gap_kwh: sum over low and high days of (inverter_kwh * site median ratio - meter_kwh), floored at 0 (high days offset meter read-time shifts) + inverter_kwh * median ratio on meter-missing days
meter_vs_inverter.label: estimated

tfrs16.remeasured_liability: book liability * actual energy / contract energy
tfrs16.note: method from the model's sheet ประเมินใหม่; confirm with the auditor

expected_energy.note: modelled contract and PVsyst kWh/day per site and calendar month (pwa_meter_expected), built from the TFRS 16 / PVsyst model workbook by `python -m app.services.pwa_meter expected --model …`; checked 21 Nov 2026 against all 1,440 imported site-months (within 0.006 kWh/day)
expected_energy.pvsyst: PVsyst P50 E_Grid of the month (sheet PVsyst_ระยะN, row = pvsyst_seq) × 1000 × site kWp ÷ PVsyst kWp ÷ days in the month
expected_energy.phase1_contract: sheet ประมาณการ_kWh (row = contract_seq) month ÷ days; a month the sheet does not cover = the same month of the latest covered year × contract_degradation_per_year per year
expected_energy.phase2_contract: kWp × first-year contract specific yield (PVsyst_ระยะ2: ผลผลิตจำเพาะตามสัญญา ระยะ 2 ปีแรก, 1,412.37 kWh/kWp/yr) × the month's share of phase 2's fleet PVsyst year ÷ days, × contract_degradation_per_year per full contract year since phase2_contract_start
expected_energy.contract_degradation_basis: assumed: the rule the days CSV used for phase 1 Oct-Nov 2026 (same month a year earlier × 0.993); applied to phase 2 from its second contract year. Not stated in the model workbook; confirm with the contract
expected_energy.phase2_contract_start_source: model sheet สมมติฐาน: ระยะที่ 2 · วันเริ่มสัญญา

report_import.note: daily report Excel import (POST /pwa/meter/import, CLI `report`): the per-site table is found by its header text; phase 2 rows match P2-<comp_id>, others by the meter number learned before, then by site name without the 'กปภ.สาขา…' suffix (phase 1 sites only). Unmatched rows are listed, never guessed
report_import.skip_before_note: days before these are commissioning / pre-contract sheets (the days CSV starts phase 1 on 17 Jan and phase 2 on 8 Jan 2026); they are counted in the preview and not stored
report_import.weather_note: first group whose keyword is in the report's สภาพอากาศ (catches the typos ฝนคก, ฝยตก, มีเมฆมมาก, มีมฆมาก; ท้องฟ้าปลอดโปร่ง = clear); no match = null with a warning
name_suffix_markers: การประปาส่วนภูมิภาค
